rows.en: My form, you say? Fufufufu... You make me laugh, you foolish "Lost Heroes"...
Feeding on the Minus Energy that gathers to me, I took in every phenomenon from all the worlds...
...and with overwhelming power, dyed it all in evil.
Every being I had no use for, I stripped of its power and sealed away in a Cube.
But you alone were never fully eliminated. You stubbornly survived.
Therefore, I shall now eliminate you with all my might!!
Minus Energy's getting sucked in...? And that ain't all... even the souls of countless kaiju!

The "Memory Memory" and the three Core Medals vanished into the Ride Gate as if sucked inside.
The Memory and the Core Medals, into the Ride Gate... Tch! This is bad...!!
Fuhahahahahaha!! The Minus Energy born of you has also become part of me, you see?
All that remains is to dispose of you, the leftover dregs.
Is that "Regis" bastard holed up in there...?
Just then, a transmission came in from the base.
"...This is Zoffy. Is everyone all right?"
"At this rate, never mind returning to our own worlds..."
"...all the worlds will be fused, and every life that loves peace will be wiped out..."
"The world will be shut away in eternal darkness, ruled by malice and despair..."

notes.note: Speakers verified against 0733.bla (MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N shows entry N+1). Regis (#116-121) answers the party's 'Show yourself!!' from story_168, hence 'My form, you say?'. #117-118 is one sentence cut at the same point as the source.

Scream block #124-138 = TextIdOffset+123+R6, R6 set by the second Pt_Chara_Check chain (variant index is an explicit LOADK, not the check position): Zero, Nu Gundam, OOO, Mebius, Zeta Gundam, W (Shotaro), Ultraman, 00, Den-O Sword Form, Seven, Wing Zero, Black RX, Taro, God Gundam, Rider 1. Each distinct Japanese scream gets a distinct English one; identical ones match. Momotaros 'Owaaah', God Gundam 'Uwoaaagh'.
Not played by the script (no MessWinSet reaches entry 145; #146 is TextIdOffset+145). Speaker unknown; neutral rendering.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36). 'a Ride Gate': a new gate appears here, not the camp's known Ride Gate.

Block #150-164 = TextIdOffset+149+R6 with the third check chain (order W (Shotaro), Mebius, Wing Zero, Black RX, Seven, Zeta Gundam, OOO, Zero, 00, Den-O Sword Form, Taro, God Gundam, Rider 1, Ultraman, Nu Gundam). Extracted label '?party' on #150 is correct (W/Shotaro, rough 'ain't'); #159 is Momotaros (rough wording in source); the rest share one neutral line.
Same leader order as #150-164 (TextIdOffset+167+R6). All variants identical. 'Memory Memory' quoted per glossary.
Ankh. 'the Medals' = the three Core Medals from story_165 (Dinosaur Greeed's purple medals), named in #185.
Regis (CHARA_NAME 228). Sentence-final '?' is a taunting rhetorical tag, kept as 'you see?'.

Script: if leader == 3 (Den-O Sword Form / Momotaros) play #201, else #194. #195-200 and #202-207 are never played; identical Japanese, identical English. Extracted 'Nu Gundam' labels on #194/#201 are wrong: #194 is any leader, #201 is Momotaros.
Momotaros: contemptuous verb form, rendered 'that "Regis" bastard holed up in there'.
Zoffy (CHARA_NAME 128) over comms; comm lines use double quotes as in story_132. Ankh answers #213.
Zoffy speaks for everyone trapped in the Cubes: 'our own worlds'. #215-216 is one sentence cut at the source's point.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0733.bla; leader-variant orders differ between blocks (#124-138 vs #150-182). Extracted labels wrong on #194/#201 (not Nu Gundam): #194 generic leader, #201 Momotaros. #145 unused by the script. No new names or terms.
